basis.footprint: Original MainShell horizontal section y=1.5, largest enclosed interior; no external map dimensions used for floor boundary.
basis.ground: Exact difference against original station/context mesh triangles whose vertex heights are within 0.12 m of ground; no square-cell seam approximation.
basis.height: y=0 matches original plaza and platform floor datum, not an independently surveyed height.
basis.status: Source-aligned reconstruction; not a verified digital twin.
basis.interior: Board identities and Naver vector topology; fitted positions remain a reference reconstruction, not verified as-built. No invented column grid or safety-equipment layout.
basis.implementationBoundaryRule: Preserve the existing station, ContextPlaza entry floors and active Ground_Floor. Inactive tenant layouts are not construction boundaries. Add only a component-specific, evidence-registered missing region after checking the actual surrounding meshes, colliders and vertical connections.
basis.temporal: 2026-08 board supplies tenant identities. May 18, 2026 published photographs (djagytt/224289573890; capture date not independently verified) supersede March hoarding and 2025 fascia evidence for ten observed 1F brands. B&C Donuts is reopened with a glazed entrance after March 3-April 2 construction, not still under construction. These are May observations, not September as-built verification. Other historical fascia remain explicitly dated. Source coordinates, aspect-estimation caveats and reference-only rights: Assets/ChooGuard/Art/StationInterior/Majibang/Textures/GroundCurrent/receipts.json. Construction-time corrections (B&C retail, ARTBOX pier, #1 identity) are applied in .planning/2026-09-23-video-twin/1f-implementation/interior-spec.json; this plan keeps the uncorrected Naver fit.
